name: H09_icewind_elemental_draws_then_discards_a_card_of_your_choice
note: Icewind Elemental: 'When this creature enters, draw a card, then discard a card.' P0 holds the Elemental and a Spare card. After the cast it draws one card (Library 5) and then discards the card it names, the Spare: the Spare is in P0's graveyard, the drawn card stays in hand (hand 1), the library lost exactly one card, and the opponent is untouched.
